meaning.en: Seemingly right but actually wrong.
meaning.zh: 好像是对的，实际上不对。

examples.zh: 网上流传着许多似是而非的健康知识。
examples.en: A lot of specious health advice circulates online.

examples.zh: 他的解释似是而非，经不起推敲。
examples.en: His explanation sounds plausible but doesn't hold up.

story.en: Mencius quotes Confucius: 'I hate what seems right but is not' (恶似而非者), such as weeds that look like grain.
story.zh: 《孟子·尽心下》：“孔子曰：恶似而非者：恶莠，恐其乱苗也……”

meaning.en: To endure all kinds of hardship, typically while raising a family.
meaning.zh: 形容忍受辛苦或受尽辛苦。

examples.zh: 母亲含辛茹苦把我们兄妹三人抚养成人。
examples.en: Mother endured every hardship to bring the three of us up.

examples.zh: 他含辛茹苦经营小店二十年。
examples.en: He toiled for twenty years running his little shop.

usage.en: Adverbial or predicate; often with 抚养/养大.
usage.zh: 多作状语、谓语，常与“抚养”连用。

natural: take bribes and pervert the law

meaning.en: To take bribes and bend the law.
meaning.zh: 贪污受贿，违犯法纪。

examples.zh: 这名官员因贪赃枉法被判刑。
examples.en: The official was jailed for taking bribes and perverting the law.

examples.zh: 贪赃枉法的人终将受到惩罚。
examples.en: Those who take bribes and bend the law will be punished in the end.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; legal and news register.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语；常见于法律、新闻。

meaning.en: Originally to raise an army; now to recruit people or expand a team.
meaning.zh: 原指组织或扩充武装力量，现也比喻扩充人员。

examples.zh: 公司刚拿到融资，正在招兵买马。
examples.en: The company has just raised funding and is busy hiring.

examples.zh: 新校长上任后招兵买马，引进了不少名师。
examples.en: The new head built up the team, bringing in many top teachers.

usage.zh: 多作谓语；口语中指招人。

meaning.en: Buffeted by wind and rain; precarious and unstable.
meaning.zh: 在风雨中飘荡不定，比喻局势动荡不安。

examples.zh: 清朝末年，国家风雨飘摇。
examples.en: In the last years of the Qing, the country was tottering.

examples.zh: 这家风雨飘摇的公司终于宣布破产。
examples.en: The struggling company finally declared bankruptcy.

story.en: The owl laments: 'my nest is in danger, tossed by wind and rain' (予室翘翘，风雨所漂摇).
story.zh: 《诗经·鸱鸮》：“予室翘翘，风雨所漂摇。”

date.zh: 西周初至春秋中叶 · 前11—前6世纪
date.en: early Western Zhou to mid Spring and Autumn, 11th–6th c. BC

meaning.en: To exhaust all one's energy and thought.
meaning.zh: 用尽精力，费尽心思。

examples.zh: 为了这个项目，他殚精竭虑，日夜操劳。
examples.en: He poured all his energy into the project, working day and night.

examples.zh: 老校长为学校的发展殚精竭虑。
examples.en: The old headmaster gave his all to the school's development.

meaning.en: Perfect in every respect.
meaning.zh: 极其完善，极其美好。

examples.zh: 世上没有尽善尽美的事。
examples.en: Nothing in the world is perfect.

examples.zh: 她做事总追求尽善尽美。
examples.en: She always strives for perfection.

story.en: Confucius said the Shao music was 'perfectly beautiful and perfectly good' (尽美矣，又尽善也).
story.zh: 《论语·八佾》：“子谓《韶》：尽美矣，又尽善也。”

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; often 追求尽善尽美.

meaning.en: Vividly portrayed, as if leaping off the page.
meaning.zh: 形容描写、刻画得十分生动逼真。

examples.zh: 作者寥寥几笔，人物形象就跃然纸上。
examples.en: With a few strokes the author makes the character leap off the page.

examples.zh: 画中的骏马跃然纸上。
examples.en: The horse in the painting seems to come alive.

meaning.en: Bold, inspiring words (sometimes implying empty boasting).
meaning.zh: 气魄很大的话；有时暗指空话。

examples.zh: 赛前他发出了夺冠的豪言壮语。
examples.en: Before the race he boldly declared he would win.

examples.zh: 光有豪言壮语不行，还得脚踏实地。
examples.en: Fine words alone won't do; you have to put in the work.

natural: go back to one's old line of work

meaning.en: To return to one's former occupation.
meaning.zh: 重新从事过去的行业。

equivalents: go back to one's old job

examples.zh: 退休后，他又重操旧业，开了一家诊所。
examples.en: After retiring he went back to his old profession and opened a clinic.

examples.zh: 出狱后，他竟重操旧业，又干起了诈骗。
examples.en: Out of prison, he went straight back to running scams.

meaning.en: Poetic and picturesque beauty.
meaning.zh: 像诗画里描绘的那样美好的意境。

examples.zh: 江南水乡充满诗情画意。
examples.en: The water towns south of the Yangtze are full of poetic charm.

examples.zh: 这首歌唱出了秋天的诗情画意。
examples.en: The song captures the poetic beauty of autumn.

usage.en: Object or attributive; often 充满诗情画意.

meaning.en: Each fighting independently without coordination.
meaning.zh: 各自独立作战，比喻不互相配合。

examples.zh: 各部门各自为战，效率很低。
examples.en: Each department goes its own way, and efficiency is poor.

examples.zh: 队员们各自为战，缺乏配合。
examples.en: The players each played their own game with no teamwork.

meaning.en: Furtive and sneaky.
meaning.zh: 形容行动偷偷摸摸，不光明正大。

examples.zh: 有个人在门口鬼鬼祟祟的，你去看看。
examples.en: Someone's lurking about suspiciously by the door; go and check.

examples.zh: 他鬼鬼祟祟地翻看别人的手机。
examples.en: He sneakily went through someone else's phone.

meaning.en: To search one's conscience; to ask oneself honestly.
meaning.zh: 摸着胸口自己问自己，指自我反省。

examples.zh: 扪心自问，我真的尽力了吗？
examples.en: Hand on heart, did I really do my best?

examples.zh: 你扪心自问，这样对他公平吗？
examples.en: Ask yourself honestly — is that fair to him?

meaning.en: Having taken great pains with good intentions.
meaning.zh: 费尽心思，用意很深。

examples.zh: 父母这样安排，真是用心良苦。
examples.en: Your parents arranged it like this with the best of intentions.

examples.zh: 老师批评你，其实是用心良苦。
examples.en: The teacher's criticism was actually well-meant.

usage.en: Predicate; often 可谓/真是用心良苦. Also as 良苦用心 (noun).
usage.zh: 多作谓语；也说“良苦用心”。

meaning.en: Exactly appropriate; neither too much nor too little.
meaning.zh: 办事或说话正合分寸。

examples.zh: 他的评价恰如其分。
examples.en: His assessment was spot on.

examples.zh: 恰如其分的赞美能鼓舞人心。
examples.en: Well-judged praise is encouraging.

meaning.en: Lasting a long time without stopping (of applause, cheers).
meaning.zh: 经过很长时间也不停止，多指掌声、欢呼声。

examples.zh: 演讲结束，台下响起经久不息的掌声。
examples.en: When the speech ended there was prolonged applause.

examples.zh: 欢呼声经久不息。
examples.en: The cheering went on and on.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; almost always with 掌声/欢呼声.
usage.zh: 多作定语、谓语，多修饰掌声。

meaning.en: Of many different shapes and appearances.
meaning.zh: 形容姿态多种多样，各不相同。

examples.zh: 溶洞里的钟乳石千姿百态。
examples.en: The stalactites in the cave come in every shape imaginable.

examples.zh: 公园里的菊花千姿百态。
examples.en: The chrysanthemums in the park are wonderfully varied.

meaning.en: Walking with faltering, unsteady steps.
meaning.zh: 形容走路缓慢、摇摆的样子。

examples.zh: 一位步履蹒跚的老人慢慢走过马路。
examples.en: An old man tottered slowly across the road.

examples.zh: 受伤后，他步履蹒跚地走下场。
examples.en: After the injury he hobbled off the pitch.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; for the elderly, injured, or figuratively a struggling economy.

meaning.en: To recuperate and rebuild (of a country after war or upheaval).
meaning.zh: 指在战争或社会大变动后，减轻负担，安定生活，恢复元气。

examples.zh: 战乱之后，朝廷实行休养生息的政策。
examples.en: After the wars, the court adopted policies to let the people recover.

examples.zh: 这片草原需要休养生息。
examples.en: The grassland needs time to recover.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; historical and policy writing.

meaning.en: Hugely popular for a time.
meaning.zh: 形容事物在一个时期内非常流行。

examples.zh: 这款游戏曾风靡一时。
examples.en: The game was all the rage at one time.

examples.zh: 喇叭裤在八十年代风靡一时。
examples.en: Flared trousers were a craze in the eighties.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“曾风靡一时”。

meaning.en: Unclear and unexplained; mysterious or murky.
meaning.zh: 不清楚，不明白；含糊或来路不正。

examples.zh: 他被不明不白地开除了。
examples.en: He was sacked without any explanation.

examples.zh: 这笔钱来得不明不白。
examples.en: This money came from somewhere murky.

meaning.en: To value boys more than girls.
meaning.zh: 重视男子，轻视女子。

examples.zh: 重男轻女的观念在一些地方仍然存在。
examples.en: The preference for sons still exists in some places.

examples.zh: 她奶奶重男轻女，总偏心哥哥。
examples.en: Her grandmother favoured boys and always doted on her brother.

meaning.en: A fierce verbal battle.
meaning.zh: 形容辩论激烈，言辞锋利。

examples.zh: 辩论赛上，双方唇枪舌剑，互不相让。
examples.en: In the debate, both sides crossed swords and neither gave way.

examples.zh: 两位候选人在电视上唇枪舌剑。
examples.en: The two candidates sparred fiercely on TV.

meaning.en: Leaning or staggering this way and that.
meaning.zh: 形容站立不稳或物体歪斜不整。

examples.zh: 他喝醉了，走路东倒西歪。
examples.en: He was drunk and lurching all over the place.

examples.zh: 台风过后，路边的树东倒西歪。
examples.en: After the typhoon, the trees along the road were leaning every which way.
